# KirovAds

> KirovAds is the consultancy of Geno Kirov, a performance marketing specialist. It helps businesses in Bulgaria and the EU audit, fix and run Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) and conversion tracking (GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Consent Mode v2). Analysis is AI-assisted; every finding is verified by a human before it reaches the client.

## Services
- [Ads & Tracking Audit](https://kirovads.com/services.html#audit): from €150, written report with prioritised fixes
- [Google Ads Management](https://kirovads.com/services.html#google-ads): from €500/month
- [Meta Ads Management](https://kirovads.com/services.html#meta-ads): from €500/month
- [Tracking Setup & Repair](https://kirovads.com/services.html#tracking): GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, CAPI, Consent Mode v2
- [Strategy & Consultancy](https://kirovads.com/services.html#strategy): from €150/hour
- [Free 30-minute review call](https://kirovads.com/contact.html)
